text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer. Are you looking 
something up on your phone?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I'm babysitting a friend's kid for a 
day soon.

Yeah. I'm looking after a friend's kid for 
a day soon.

text_block_list.text:
Because of that, I was hoping to gift that 
five-year-old a picture book or take her 
out somewhere, but...
choice_data_list: ああ。今度、友人の子どもを一日預かるんだ
うん。今度、友人の子どもを一日預かるの
choice_data_list_en: Yeah. I'm babysitting a friend's kid for a day soon.
Yeah. I'm babysitting a friend's kid for the day soon.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see... Well, if that's the case, please 
let me help out too.
choice_data_list: 絵本も場所も、なかなか決まらなくて……
choice_data_list_en: I just can't decide on the picture book or the location...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go together. To scout the place 
out—for her!"

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list:
Mornin'... Whoa! That casual outfit really 
suits you!

Mornin'... Wow! That casual outfit is so 
cute!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank you very much. Truth be 
told, I was originally planning on coming 
in my usual clothes.
choice_data_list: おはよ……おお！私服、似合ってるね！
おはよ……わあ！私服、かわいいね！
choice_data_list_en: Mornin'... Whoa! Your casual outfit looks great on you!
Mornin'... Wow! Your casual outfit is so cute!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle gave me advice, saying, 
"Since it's a special occasion, you should 
dress in something autumn-themed~."
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's the perfect outfit for autumn!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aha. If hearing you say that is my reward, 
Trainer, then it was totally worth wearing 
this.
choice_data_list: うん、秋にぴったりの装いだね！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, that outfit is perfect for autumn!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That kid reads a lot of books, right? I 
wonder if she's read famous picture books, 
then...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The Happy Prince," huh? I love it, but 
maybe something more obscure—like "The 
Water of Life"? Though she might already 
know Grimm's Fairy Tales...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's look for a new release. That 
way, she's sure to encounter a picture 
book she's never seen beforeâ

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! This is by my favorite author! It's 
already out...? I had no idea.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"‘The Swan's Errand’... Hehe, looks 
interesting. Though, it might be a bit too 
easy for a five-year-old—"

After having K.S.Miracle pick out two 
picture books, we leave the bookstore. 
Both the insightful fairy tale and the fun 
educational book were wonderful choices.
choice_data_list: Thanks for helping me!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about that. More 
importantly...
choice_data_list: 協力してくれてありがとう！
choice_data_list_en: Thanks for helping out!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry about this. Buying one for me 
too, I mean.
choice_data_list:
Because your eyes were sparkling! I just 
had to give it to you!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. You saw an embarrassing side of 
me, didn't you...
choice_data_list: だって、目が輝いてたから。あげたくて！
choice_data_list_en: Because your eyes were sparkling! I just had to give it to you!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"This park isn't very crowded even on 
weekends, so I think it's a great place to 
relax."

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"We could read the picture book I gave her 
together here... and there are swan boats 
too, so that might be nice if she wants to 
be more active."
choice_data_list: Huh, a swan boat! That sounds fun!
Huh, a swan boat! That sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Once we've rested a bit, shall we go 
take a look over there as well?
choice_data_list: へえ、スワンボート！面白そうだな！
へえ、スワンボート！面白そうだね！
choice_data_list_en: Oh, swan boats! That sounds fun!
Oh, swan boats! That sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer. Isn't it about time I 
took a turn rowing?"
choice_data_list: It's fine! Leave today to me! Uooooh!
It's fine! Leave today to me! Uooooh!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu... You are so kind. However――
choice_data_list: 大丈夫！今日は俺に任せて！うおおお！
大丈夫！今日は私に任せて！うおおお！
choice_data_list_en: Don't worry! Leave today to me! Uooooh!
Don't worry! Leave today to me! Uooooh!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
See? I told you I was faster, didn't I? 
Ahaha.
choice_data_list: おおっ……？ちょ、勢いが……ミラクル！？
choice_data_list_en: Whoa...? W-Wait, that momentum... Miracle?!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haa... That swan boat was so much fun. I 
guess I got a little too excited.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Where shall we head next? This park has 
lovely flower beds too! Shall we go take a 
peek there as well?
choice_data_list: Ah, nice! I bet she'll love it!

Yeah, sounds great! I'm sure she'll love 
it!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: That girl...—
choice_data_list: ああ、いいね！あの子も喜んでくれそう！
うん、いいね！あの子も喜んでくれそう！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, sounds great! I'm sure she'll love it!
Yeah, nice! I bet she'll love it!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
choice_data_list: ...? What's the matter?
...? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: “......I'm sorry, Trainer. I...”
choice_data_list: ……？どうしたんだ？
……？どうしたの？
choice_data_list_en: ...? What's wrong?
...? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For a moment... I completely forgot we 
were just scouting. I was just having so 
much fun...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so unfair.

K.S.Miracle looked thoroughly 
embarrassed, her cheeks flushed red. 
Seeing her like that—
choice_data_list: You're having fun— what's wrong with that?
What's wrong with you having fun?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.
choice_data_list: 君が楽しんで、何がいけないの？
貴方が楽しんで、何がいけないの？
choice_data_list_en: What's wrong with you having fun?
What's wrong with you enjoying yourself?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
choice_data_list: 楽しい時は、“楽しい”でいいんだよ
choice_data_list_en: When you're having fun, just enjoying it is enough.

text_block_list.text:
Having fun while scouting isn't a bad 
thing at all. Looking into her eyes, I 
told her there was no need to blame 
herself, and continued—
choice_data_list: Well then, where should we go next?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ............ Thank you very much.
choice_data_list: それじゃあ、次はどこに行こうか？
choice_data_list_en: Alright then, where should we go next?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
In that case, um... just the flowerbed. 
Could I take one last, proper look at it?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want her to have fun, too. Her, 
as well."

K.S.Miracle looked thoroughly 
embarrassed, her cheeks flushed red. 
Seeing her like that—
choice_data_list: Then maybe I am too!
Then maybe I am too!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh...? You too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: だったら、俺もそうかも！
だったら、私もそうかも！
choice_data_list_en: Then maybe I am too!
Then maybe I am too!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: “......Ahaha. I see—”
choice_data_list: 俺も、下見のことを忘れてる時あったから！
私も、下見のことを忘れてる時あったから！
choice_data_list_en: There were times I forgot to scout ahead too, you know!
There've been times I forgot about scouting the course too!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad to hear you say that. 
Hehe..."

K.S.Miracle looked thoroughly 
embarrassed, her cheeks flushed red. 
Seeing her like that—
choice_data_list: It's not unfair at all. Not even a bit.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: ずるくないよ。全然、ずるくない
choice_data_list_en: It's not unfair. Not unfair at all.

text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I'd rather she be even more 
selfish. In her case, that would probably 
be just right."
choice_data_list: Want to go take a look at the flower bed?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
choice_data_list: 花壇のほう、見に行ってみない？
choice_data_list_en: Want to go check out the flowerbed?
